hebrew: אֹמַר לַצָּפוֹן תֵּנִי, וּלְתֵימָן אַל-תִּכְלָאִי; הָבִיאִי בָנַי מֵרָחוֹק, וּבְנוֹתַי מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ
translation:
I shall say to the North- Give them to me,

and to Yemen- set them free!

Bring my sons from afar, and my daughters from the end of the earth.

Translation by Gabe Seed
information:
Words from Isaiah 43:10

Taught by Nahum Binder, שליטא to Nativ 26
